entry.title: 道路拼接与同伦相容的论证

values.en: Argument. In (t,s), t is homotopy time and s is the path parameter. Both branches equal b at s=1/2; the closed-set pasting lemma gives joint continuity. At t=0,1 the formula gives the two concatenated paths, and the endpoints stay a,c. The product pattern binds t and s without currying the continuous map; scaled interval arguments are taken in the indicated branches.
values.zh-CN: 论证。在 (t,s) 中，t 是同伦时间，s 是道路参数。两段在 s=1/2 同取 b，闭集粘合保证联合连续；t=0、1 时分别得到两条拼接道路，且端点保持 a、c。积模式同时绑定 t、s，不将连续映射改为普通柯里化函数；缩放后的区间参数按所在分支取值。
